label_schema.warning: These labels combine filename/path/animation metadata with a lightweight alpha-silhouette detector. They are not APES ground-truth body-part correspondence labels.

fields.source_family: Duelyst faction/source prefix inferred from the unit file name.
fields.body_class: Final broad visual class after combining filename hints with detector evidence.
fields.detector_class: Broad visual class inferred from the representative sprite silhouette.
fields.detector_metrics: Alpha-mask geometry and color-footprint measurements used by the detector.
fields.combat_role: Very coarse filename-derived role: general, caster, ranged, melee, or unknown.
fields.training_role: How this asset should enter the local fine-tuning/review path.
fields.animation_labels: Animation names normalized from Unity animation clips.
fields.asset_labels: Flat tags useful for filtering manifests and review batches.
fields.label_confidence: high/medium/low confidence for broad triage labels.
fields.needs_manual_review: True because these are review labels, not supervised segmentation truth.
